name: magic-hour
description: Create and finish AI media with reusable Magic Hour workflows and inspectable output examples.

interface.shortDescription: Remix photos, performances and ideas into videos
interface.longDescription: Choose a media workflow, reuse approved references, inspect real outputs and finish editable assets with Magic Hour's MCP or API. Skills are free to install; generation requires a connected account and credits.
defaultPrompt: Animate this photo into an impossible scene while keeping me recognizable.
Put my face into this clip and preserve the performance.
Make my character perform the action in this video.
Study this reference and make an original finished short with my media.
